column7: 2026-11-05: ReDoS audit of index.js: parseRegExp is linear (160k-char hostile inputs <1.1ms). formatThousandsRegExp and formatDecimalsRegExp are quadratic when run directly on long input, but format() only feeds them toFixed() output (<=~21 integer digits, one dot), so they are unreachable via the public API. No code change made. Bench script was /tmp/redos/bench.js.

2026-11-05: IEC units (KiB..PiB) added to parse() in index.js by stripping the 'i' with plain string handling before the existing parseRegExp, because of the AppSec no-new-regex rule. format() deliberately not changed (user only asked for parse). Unknown units like 1EiB fall back to parseInt (returns 1), same as existing behaviour for junk suffixes. Changes uncommitted.
